name: Gongorinan — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Gongorinan from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Qlippoth, Gongorinan" but are not part of the Gongorinan entry, which is unchanged.

Special Attacks bleed (1d6), constrict (1d6+7), horrific appearance (DC 20), oviposition, psionic fist +2, violent destruction (10 ft., 11d8, DC 22), web (+17 ranged, DC 22, 11 hp)
Psi-Like Abilities (ML 15th; concentration +16)

Constant—defy gravity, slip the bonds
At Will—suspend life
3/day—defensive precognition (+4 bonus, swift action), fuse flesh (DC 23)
1/day—brutalize wounds (DC 21), fold space (move action), matter manipulation (DC 23)
